name: Ashvath
overview: Ashvath was a male member of the tribe of Asher, known primarily as the son of Japhlet. His identification is concise, with no additional notes or elaboration beyond his lineage. This places him within the genealogical record of the tribe of Asher in ancient Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Ashvath is a proper name that possibly means 'wrought iron.' This meaning suggests a name associated with strength or durability, although the name was not given by God. The only biblical reference for this name is found in 1 Chronicles 7:33.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Ashvath as the son of Japhlet, linking him directly to his father within the tribe of Asher. No other family relationships are documented in the biblical text beyond this father-son connection.
scriptureSignificance: Ashvath's significance lies chiefly in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Asher, as presented in 1 Chronicles 7:33. While the biblical text does not elaborate on his personal deeds or roles, his inclusion underscores the importance of lineage and tribal heritage in God's covenant people. His mention contributes to the preservation of Israel's tribal identities and the fulfillment of God's promises through the descendants of Jacob.
